lead: Captured aviation software signals reveal active customer adoptions and platform enhancements across EFB, flight planning, and dispatch vendors, with notable low-cost carrier wins concentrated in specific portfolios.

insights.title: IFS Secures Multiple LCC and Regional Adoptions
insights.finding: IFS captured multiple customer wins for its IFS EFBOne platform, including selections by fastjet and MY FREIGHTER LLC (Centrum Air), demonstrating traction in the EFB market.
insights.aviation_context: fastjet is an African low-cost carrier, and MY FREIGHTER / Centrum Air is classified as an LCC.
insights.caveat: Captured feed visibility reflects public relations announcements rather than total industry market share.

insights.title: Jeppesen Expands ForeFlight Dispatch Capabilities
insights.finding: Jeppesen introduced new Airflow agents and trip feasibility features for its ForeFlight Dispatch platform at NBAA-BACE 2026.
insights.aviation_context: ForeFlight Dispatch caters to business aviation and commercial flight planning workflows.
insights.caveat: Announcements reflect new software feature rollouts rather than verified fleet-wide operational deployment metrics.

insights.title: Thales (Aviobook) Secures Royal Air Maroc Agreement
insights.finding: Thales signed a five-year agreement with Royal Air Maroc to deploy the AvioBook Flight EFB platform across its pilot workforce.
insights.aviation_context: Royal Air Maroc operates as a network carrier connecting Africa, Europe, and the Americas.
insights.caveat: Relationship status is based on a single captured contract announcement.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Leverages Customer Testimonials on LinkedIn
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems heavily utilized LinkedIn to publish customer implementation updates and video testimonials featuring carriers like KLM, Finnair, and Kenya Airways.
insights.aviation_context: Digital flight operations platforms rely on active pilot adoption and interface feedback.
insights.caveat: LinkedIn captures combine live-scraper and Google News sources, which can influence observed posting volume.

insights.title: Navblue Expands TransNusa Digital Suite Integration
insights.finding: TransNusa expanded its collaboration with Navblue by adopting Skywise Core X2 and S.FP+ to integrate flight and technical operations.
insights.aviation_context: Skywise products integrate aircraft health monitoring with operational data streams.
insights.caveat: Captured signals emphasize commercial agreement announcements rather than implementation completion timelines.
